shots.name: storm-boat-v3
shots.sourceBrief: Create a memorable AutoPromote welcome film and social campaign from an idea alone, with no recorded footage. Show imagination becoming finished work, rather than a feature list.
shots.storyRole: tension: the same fragile boat actually encounters the wave
shots.prompt: The same single small ivory origami sailboat is visibly threatened by a huge rising ocean swell. Keep its exact crisp folded hull and tall triangular sail intact, keep the boat in the centre lower third, fully inside frame throughout. At water level the camera tracks with the boat as the dark blue sea rises steeply behind it into a towering curling wave. The tiny boat visibly lifts and tilts while riding upward along the water surface. White spray blows sideways off the wave crest, drops pass the lens, deep petrol-blue shadows and a narrow warm amber rim light. The wave grows to dominate the upper frame, dwarfing the fragile paper boat still visible below. Physically convincing flowing water, extreme scale contrast and tactile paper. One continuous controlled cinematic five-second shot with actual movement and growing danger. No vanishing boat, no extra objects, no cutting to another scene, no text.
